description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various reinforcement learning methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, and PPO—across three multimodal reasoning benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with tick marks at 2% intervals. Each benchmark on the horizontal axis contains five grouped bars, each corresponding to a method as indicated by the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (diagonal striped blue-gray), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (diagonal striped orange), and PPO (diagonal striped green). In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves ~56.1%, DAPO ~53.2%, SRPO ~55.8%, GRPO ~53.5%, and PPO ~53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches ~57.0%, DAPO ~56.0%, SRPO ~57.2%, GRPO ~55.8%, and PPO ~54.6%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection peaks at ~61.0%, followed by SRPO at ~60.7%, GRPO at ~58.2%, DAPO at ~57.6%, and PPO at ~57.0%. The chart visually emphasizes that DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO consistently outperform the others, especially on Physics, where DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy across all methods and benchmarks.
